 Judgment
Learned counsel for the appellants submits that the parties have settled the matter before the trial court and a memo is filed enclosing the joint memo filed by the parties in this regard.
He seeks for permission to withdraw this appeal and for refund of the statutory deposit of Rs.25,000/- made by the appellants before this Court.
2. In view of the above, this appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
3. The registry is directed to refund the statutory deposit of Rs.25,000/- made by the appellants before this Court, after due verification.
